headline_seed: DHS confirms just 185 non-citizens on Nevada voter rolls after claiming there were thousands more - The Guardian
draft_text:
DHS confirmed just 185 of 15,903 flagged Nevada voters as non-citizens after manual review, CNN and The Guardian report. DHS official Kimberley Vogt called the 15,903 figure a "ceiling" that had not undergone full review.

And that's the mews.
